data.vehicle_damage_summary: The vehicle sustained significant collision impact to the front left quadrant, resulting in a completely missing left front headlamp assembly and wheel assembly. The left front fender is structurally buckled and carries a hand-written 'REPLACE.' notation. In the exposed wheel well, the left steering gear inner tie rod is severely bent and disconnected, while the front bumper cover exhibits minor scraping and alignment issues on its left edge.
